BILL HANDYMAN, LLC At Your Service At Mr. Bill Handyman, LLC, your satisfaction is our main priority. Quality work with precision and meticulous attention to detail is our guarantee. We are fully licensed and insured and ready to take on any project you may have in mind. Rest assured we have your back! Fully licensed & insured with TWIC government clearance NJ license #13VH11636400 ​​PA license #200387 Email us with your dream Now! MR. BILL HANDYMAN, LLC A Closer Look at who we are We are Julie and Bill, hardworking people whose lives revolve around our home and family. With 25 years of experience in home improvement, renovation and repair - and knowing how to live on a budget - we can help you create your ideal home environment and keep it in tip-top shape without breaking the bank. We go above and beyond with exquisite attention to detail that will keep us fresh in your minds for any project. Explore the rest of our site to learn more about what we offer. Call for your free estimate appointment today! Call us for your Free Estimate OUR SERVICES What We Provide FLOORING Our customers are who matter most At Mr. Bill, we provide a wide variety of flooring needs. From repair, to demo or new installation, Mr. Bill will happily service any of your flooring needs! Call today. Set up your flooring Estimate today HOME REMODEL, RENOVATIONS AND REPAIR Exceptional Service We offer home remodel, renovations, and many other services at great rates, all while providing clients with personalized attention that is catered to your needs. All of our services, exist to make your life easier and stress free. Would you like to learn more? Get in touch with us today to schedule your free estimate. How can we help you? BACKSPLASHES Satisfaction Guaranteed A backsplash is the "make or break" of any kitchen or bathroom. Trust Mr. Bill to install the perfect addition. We work with a variety of materials and aim for pure customer satisfaction. Let us help you transform your space SO. MUCH. MORE... We are here for YOU Do you have a project or idea that you would like to bring to life? We provide our clients with a wide range of contracting services at competitive market rates. If you’re looking for a certified expert for your next project, please get in touch today. We would be more than happy to answer any and all of your questions. Mr. Bill has a number of additional services. Call to find out what we can do for you today. Let's talk about what YOU dream of! THE ODD JOBS Confidence in excellence, nothing less Mr. Bill wears many hats. We offer additional indoor and outdoor services. Dare to think outside the box. You can trust us with confidence to correctly complete many other odd jobs around your home. After all, we aren't just a general contractor, we're a handyman. It's what we do. Gutter clean outs, Yard debris and clean ups, Cement touch ups, Power washing, Patio door installation and replacement, Deck staining, repair and construction, Ceiling fan and lighting installation, Sheet rocking, ceiling and wall repair, Garbage disposal and appliance installation, Spackling and Painting, Trim and frame work, Carpentry and Woodwork projects, Soffit repair and more. Never hurts to ask... Have a question? Find your answers here How can we help you transform that space? Fix that problem? Make your home more comfortable? Give us a call, send us an email, or fill out the contact form and we will do our very best to get back to you in one business day. You can also visit us on Facebook! (Link at the bottom of this page) Now serving McKean & Potter Counties and surrounding areas! M-F 8am-6pm Email us! Call us today! CONTACT We are committed to all of our clients, and look forward to working with you. Questions, comments or special requests? We would love to hear from you. Between crunching numbers for Mr. Bill, designing bathrooms & kitchens (and painting or lending in a hand in demo when she can) she works full time and homeschools the Groen's youngest son. Bill Groen Bill is a jack of all trades. There is no job he won't take as a challenge. Bill is meticulous with his work and has been working on homes since he was a young boy alongside his dad and uncle who are also both very skilled tradesmen. He has over 25 years experience and just like fine wine with some aged cheese he gets better as more time goes on. Why we started our business! We have always made a terrific team. We started Mr. Bill so that we both could lend time to raising our son who needed more of our attention. Mr. Bill was a perfect way to do that! Knowing just how it is to live on a budget with a family, we created a family driven business to help others just like us. Real people with real needs. No price gouging, no unfair markups, just an honest job for honest pay. Making memories Making memories is one of the MOST important things we can do for our families.
